title: Pasulka and Vallee: aliens as the modern form of angels and demons

tellings.quote: there's a religious studies Professor named Diana Pula and there's a guy named jacqu Val this French ufologist both of whom believe that aliens are sort of the Contemporary version of Angels and Demons

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, points to two thinkers: Diana Pasulka, a professor of religious studies, and Jacques Vallee, a French researcher of UFOs. Michels says both believe that what people now call aliens are a modern version of what earlier ages called angels and demons, which would mean the same kind of presence has been with us all along under different names.
